apks.help: Download Hexen II VR from SideQuest and pick the APK file.

inputs.label: Hexen II (Steam)
inputs.help: Your installed copy of Hexen II from Steam. qgp uses the pak files in its data1 folder.

steps.text: Open Hexen II VR from Library > Unknown Sources.

notes: The payload download URL is the uhexen2 README, not an APK, and uhexen2 has no GitHub releases. The guide only says "install from SideQuest"; the exact SideQuest page is unknown, so page is the SideQuest home page. Steam app ID left out because it is not confirmed here. The payload expects only pak0.pak; the guide copies pak0.pak and pak1.pak.
